episodes.synopsis:
I'm Nodoka Hanadera! I'm a 2nd year middle school student who just moved to Sukoyaka City!

As I strolled through the city, a monster suddenly appeared in the park! And that's when I noticed a sick dog trying to run away. But according to Rabirin, a rabbit fairy, and her animal friends, Latte couldn't be treated at your average hospital. They needed some sort of "special treatment".

And that's when a glowing wand appeared before me and Rabirin.
episodes.title: Holding Hands Tightly! We're Pretty Cure ♥ Cure Grace

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka and Rabirin have decided they'd protect the Earth together, but after seeing how nonathletic Nodoka is, Rabirin comes to the conclusion that she needs a "new partner"!?
episodes.title: No Longer Partners!? I Guess I'm No Good?

episodes.synopsis: Chiyu is the daughter of the hot spring inn. And a part of the spring was targeted by the Byogens! Wanting to help restore it, Chiyu and Pegitan decided.
episodes.title: Overflowing Feelings! Transform Into Cure Fontaine!

episodes.synopsis: Hinata and Nyatoran get along as soon as they come across each other! After seeing Nodoka and Chiyu transform into Pretty Cure, Hinata is very surprised...
episodes.title: I Want To Be Cute! The Birth of Cure Sparkle

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka takes Chiyu and Hinata, who aren't getting along, to the aquarium so they can become better friends. But when they get there, they lose sight of Pegitan...
episodes.title: Awkward Day At The Aquarium! We're All So Different

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka's mother, Yasuko goes back to work. But Rate who was left alone at home, escapes...?
episodes.title: Where's Mom ~latte? The Great Escape!

episodes.synopsis: A male student is following Nodoka around at school as he suspects Nodoka has something to do with the most recent monster attacks. So Michio keeps nagging her, to which she struggles to keep her Pretty Cure identity a secret.
episodes.title: Big News!? Nodoka's Secret

episodes.synopsis: The Spring Athletics Tournament is coming up and everything is looking great until Chiyu suddenly falls into a slump. Smiling at Nodoka and Pegitan, Chiyu keeps practising, but...
episodes.title: Chiyu Can't Jump!? Trouble At The Athletics Tournament!

episodes.synopsis: Hinata takes the others to an event where you can take photos of the outfits you wear! This should be a fun day to make some cute memories but then a Byogen appears!?
episodes.title: Hinata's Cute Plan!

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka and the others go on a field trip to visit a museum. Meanwhile, Guaiwaru, Daruizen and Shindoine decide to attack at the same time!?
episodes.title: Emergency Treatment! There's Multiple Megabyogen!?

episodes.synopsis: Of the three Megabyogens that appeared at the same time, only two were purified. And the last one remaining was becoming stronger unlike any that came before it....
episodes.title: Combining Powers! Miracle Healing!

episodes.synopsis: Rabirin comes up with an idea for Nodoka and the others to undergo special training to strengthen their teamwork. As the training doesn't go as planned, a new Byogen appears...
episodes.title: Thoughts As One! The Great Teamwork Plan

episodes.synopsis: Hinata is feeling uncertain about continuing as a Pretty Cure after fighting Batetemoda, when suddenly, an invisible Megabyogen appears!?
episodes.title: To Quit Or To Not Quit? A Confused Hinata!

episodes.synopsis: Ever since Nodoka has came to live in Sukoyaka City, she has felt healthy. Along with Chiyu and Hinata, they attend the city's festival where they discover the secret behind Sukoyaka City's healthiness.
episodes.title: Discovering Happiness! Sukoyaka Festival!

episodes.synopsis: It is love at first sight for Rabirin when she sees a popular character. When Nodoka buys Rabirin the plushie, Rabirin suddenly says she doesn't want it...
episodes.title: Our First Fight... Nodoka and Rabirin Go Their Separate Ways

episodes.synopsis: The legend says that if you pledge friendship under the tree, you will stay friends forever. When Nodoka and her friends meet an old man, they try to help reconcile things between his former friend, but...
episodes.title: The Oath of Friendship! Beneath the Tree of Eternity

episodes.synopsis: Chiyu decides to help out at the inn while Nakai-san takes a break. However, Chiyu struggles to entertain a customer who is staying at the inn...
episodes.title: The Finest Hospitality!? Chiyu's Hostess Training

episodes.synopsis: When Nyatoran meets a lady at a fragrance shop, his heart skip a beat, so he tries to tell her how he feels...
episodes.title: Straight To The Heart! Nyatoran Returns The Favor

episodes.synopsis: Rate's physical health has gotten worse, to the point that there's nothing that can treat her. However, when Nodoka and the others are in a pinch, Rate tries to fight back for them!?
episodes.title: Protect Rate...! The Wind of Prayers and The Girl of Miracles

episodes.synopsis: A spirit who looks like the past Pretty Cure has saved Rate. But then she tries to take Rate back to the Healing Garden...?
episodes.title: Now, With Our Combined Wish...! We Are Cure Earth

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka has decided to let Asumi stay at her house after learning that Asumi has nowhere to live. But this is Asumi's first time living in the human world...
episodes.title: Nice To Meet You! I'm Fuurin Asumi

episodes.synopsis: Rate avoids Asumi due to how overprotective she is. Chiyu steps in and teaches Asumi the feeling of "love"...
episodes.title: Please Don't Run Away Rate! A Disappearing Body And Blooming Feelings

episodes.synopsis: A dog named Pocchito is being looked after at the Hiramitsu Animal Clinic. Everyone thinks its eyebrows are "cute", but Asumi doesn't know what "cute" is...
episodes.title: What is "Cute"? The Story Of Asumi And The Puppy

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka and her friends go hiking by a lakeside near Ooraka City, when they meet the arborist, Sakuya. Later that day, a Megabyogen appears in the lake...
episodes.title: I'm Going Now! Rely On The Treatment To Ride The Wind

episodes.synopsis: Pegitan goes for walk after watching a scary movie, when he is found by a little girl...
episodes.title: Be Brave! Pegitan Is Trapped

episodes.synopsis: Asumi wants to write a diary about observing Latte. However, Asumi doesn't know where the others are when all she wants to know is what Latte was like before she was born...
episodes.title: Surprise! Asumi and Latte's Diary

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka's father, Takeshi, invites Nodoka and her friends to watch his juniors in a balloon competition. When a team member is unable to participate, Asumi decides to be their replacement.
episodes.title: Fly The Balloon! Asumi and Latte's Hot Feelings

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka is in pain after having a Mega Part forced inside her. However, when Rabirin and the others combine their powers to get it out of her, something else appears...
episodes.title: In Pain Again!? Daruizen, Are You?

episodes.synopsis: After regaining her health, Nodoka starts to run more than she has ever done before. Worried, Rabirin and the others try to find a way to calm her down.
episodes.title: Nodoka In Distress? Let's Have A Change Of Pace♪

episodes.synopsis: When the girls go the zoo, they bump into their teacher, Maruyama sensei, and his son Kouta. However, Kouta had an argument with his friend who was supposed to come to the zoo as well...
episodes.title: The Characters Have Been Separated? The Holiday At The Zoo

episodes.synopsis: The Cures have to fight a powered up Megabyogen known as a Gigabyogen, right after their previous battle at the zoo. However, the Gigabyogen quickly overwhelms them!?
episodes.title: The Byogens Have Evolved! The Treatment Is The Healin' Good Arrow!

episodes.synopsis: Chiyu's younger brother, Touji, wants to take part in the work experience that Nodoka and her friends are doing. However, he continuously fails to do anything right...
episodes.title: Just Like My Sister! My Host Training

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka's former doctor, Dr. Hachisuka has come to visit Sukoyaka City. However, Nodoka is informed that Dr. Hachisuka has actually resigned after feeling bad about not finding a cure to help Nodoka...
episodes.title: A Reunion Full Of Memories! The Gift My Past Self Left Behind

episodes.synopsis: Chiyu beat Takami Tsubasa in the Autumn Track-and-Field event. Tsubasa than declares that she'll meet Chiyu again at the world's championship.
episodes.title: I'm My Own Rival!? The Wings Chiyu Desires

episodes.synopsis: Asumi uses her wind power to take the girls to a southern island. There, Nodoka and the others devote their time to playing volleyball under the watchful eyes of Coach Latte and Rabirin!
episodes.title: Throw It With Your Hands! Treat The Ball Connected To Your Youth!

episodes.synopsis: Hinata feels anxious after meeting her friend, Eriko, who she hasn't seen in a while. Hinata also starts studying so she can attend the same high school as Nodoka and Chiyu...
episodes.title: Gloomy Natasha. Our Special Study Camp

episodes.synopsis: To entertain Latte, the Healing Animals take her into Sukoyaka City during the tourist season. Everyone also gets together to talk about the upcoming new year...
episodes.title: Enjoy The Seasons♥ Hospitality Tour For Latte!

episodes.synopsis: To entertain Latte, the Healing Animals take her into Sukoyaka City during the tourist season. Everyone also gets together to talk about the upcoming new year...
episodes.title: Innkeeper? High Jump? Chiyu's Inner Conflict!

episodes.synopsis: The Cures are able to go to the Byogen Kingdom after entering a portal Guaiwaru had come out of!? So they finally come face to face with King Byogen...!?
episodes.title: The Final Battle At Last!? Fly To The Byogen Kingdom!

episodes.synopsis: Everything that just happened was all apart of Guaiwaru's plan!? Grace and the other Cures are quickly overpowered by King Guaiwaru's power.
episodes.title: The Birth of Hinata's Regrets! King Guaiwaru

episodes.synopsis: Grace and the others confront the Megabyogens that are infecting the streets of Sukoyaka City. But then a shadow suddenly appears before them...
episodes.title: Crisis in Sukoyaka City! The King's Shadow Draws Near

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka blames herself for rejecting Daruizen. Meanwhile, Daruizen is trapped and has no other choice but to evolve again...
episodes.title: Nodoka's Choice! Something to Protect

episodes.synopsis: King Byogen absorbs Daruizen, and evolves again. Meanwhile, Teatinu finally appears before Grace and the others...!?
episodes.title: King's Evolution! Sukoyaka City Has Been Eroded

episodes.synopsis: King Byogen starts infecting the planet after escaping from Teatinu's cage. But despite this, Nodoka and the others refuse to give up...
episodes.title: Let's Heal It Together!! For A Healthy Future

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka and the others are brought to the Healing Garden. As they struggle to fight the Megabyogen, someone appears in response to Latte's wish...
episodes.title: The Healing Garden
